directions.name: Watercolor workshop
directions.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / icon-family concept art.
Input images: the three supplied existing Studioodle paintings are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: a warm wooden easel with rolled cream paper and teal/coral paint, an illustrated open coloring book, and a curled paper stack. Do not edit or reproduce those scenes. Transfer their handmade ink contours, paper warmth, natural material detail, color and gentle depth into a new UI icon contact sheet.
Direction D: "Watercolor workshop". More alive and dimensional than flat glyphs, less layered/cut-paper than the earlier Paper Charms idea. Small hand-illustrated studio objects with fine dark blue-brown outlines, luminous cream paper, translucent teal/coral watercolor accents, tiny warm-wood and dull-brass details. Closely related to the supplied easel and paper paintings. Restrained texture and a shallow, soft sense of volume, welcoming to adults and children. No shiny plastic.
Composition: a landscape deep-navy review board, EXACTLY three columns by two rows. In reading order show six coordinated icons: 1 OPEN BOOK with asymmetric curled pages, a clear gold PLUS outside its upper-right corner; 2 artist BRUSH with natural wooden handle, simple bristles and teal paint tip; 3 tipped FILL BUCKET with an obvious rim, handle and ONE pouring paint drop; 4 two overlapping STICKER SHEETS with a curled peel corner and one simple five-point star on the front; 5 artist COLOR PALETTE with three generous paint wells; 6 a clear curved left-pointing UNDO ARROW, without a star, badge, dots or decorations attached.
Each cell: enlarged icon, then two smaller preview buttons below, the same icon on a warm-ivory rounded-square button and a navy rounded-square button. Consistent visual weight, comparable scale, generous breathing space.
Keep silhouettes legible for eventual 26–32px controls. Give each object only the material/detail it needs. Book pages need no tiny drawings or lettering. Magic comes from curled paper, warm light and graceful curves, not repeated sparkles, whiskers or dashes. No floating stars, no plus-shaped decorative glints; the ONLY plus is the book's true ADD badge. No faces, mascots, pink/purple theme, excessive fantasy ornament, glitter, heavy frames, long shadows or black slabs behind icons. No text, labels, logos, numerals or watermark.

directions.name: Handmade keepsakes
directions.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / icon-family concept art.
Use the three supplied Studioodle interface paintings ONLY as material and mood references: their wooden easel, warm curled cream paper, coloring-book pages, natural ink outlines, teal/coral paint and golden accents. Do not reproduce the full reference scenes.
Direction E: "Handmade keepsakes". A coordinated set of small lovingly made artist-studio objects. Warm honey-colored wood and cream paper, quiet hand-painted teal and dusty-coral accents, softly worn rounded edges, a little visible natural grain, fine organic dark contours. Gentle shallow depth and subtle grounding shadows, calm soft light. Inviting and gender-neutral, appealing to adults as well as children, crafted rather than toy-like. Less speckled and less busy than a watercolor-splashed set; let warm materials provide the life.
Landscape deep-navy board, exactly THREE columns and TWO rows. Six icons in reading order: (1) OPEN book with two or three soft asymmetric paper page layers and a thin warm wood-colored cover, a PLAIN UNFRAMED PLUS outside the upper-right corner; (2) artist brush with warm wooden handle, dull brass collar, a clear broad bristle tip and a little teal paint; (3) a small tipped cream enamel paint bucket with a simple wood grip and one pouring drop; (4) overlapping cream sticker sheets with one bold star and a generous peeled corner, no extra little motifs; (5) a pale warm wooden artist palette with three broad quiet paint wells; (6) a smoothly carved left-sweeping UNDO arrow with a subtly hand-painted teal face and warm wood edge.
Per cell show one enlarged icon, and underneath it two small rounded-square button examples: warm-ivory button on the left, navy button on the right, same icon in each. Keep consistent scale, silhouette weight and material vocabulary.
Avoid decorative framing around individual symbols, screws, bolts, stamped lettering, glossy varnish, hard bevels, metallic medallions, cartoon faces or over-bulky 3D. Never turn the plus into a star; never put it inside a circle or on the book cover. No sparkles, whiskers or decorative dashes attached to undo or the other tools. No extra flowers or miniature page pictures. Maintain clear brush, bucket, peel and left-arrow meanings at small scale. No text, numerals, labels, watermarks or logos.

directions.name: Gouache daydream
directions.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / icon-family concept art.
The three supplied existing Studioodle easel, book and paper-stack paintings are references for warm cream paper, curled forms, teal/coral/gold color and handmade welcoming character ONLY. Intentionally reinterpret the medium instead of copying their fine ink outlines or detailed wood/paper grain.
Direction F: "Gouache daydream". Six beautiful little PAINTED OBJECTS in a soft contemporary storybook gouache style. Rich but muted opaque pigment, rounded asymmetric forms, broad painterly color areas, soft modeled volume and gentle highlights. No black contour lines, no hard woodgrain, no crumpled parchment texture, no cut-paper collage layers. Not flat silhouettes: light and shade should make the objects feel alive and touchable, but keep the detail broad and icon-friendly. Adult-and-child appeal, calm, magical through graceful form rather than fantasy decoration.
Landscape navy board, EXACTLY THREE columns and TWO rows. Reading order: 1 OPEN BOOK with gently curled cream pages and a muted teal cover, a plain unframed GOLD PLUS outside its upper-right corner, no tiny page pictures; 2 a curved teal-handled artist BRUSH with a broad cream bristle tip and one paint accent; 3 a rounded dusty-coral FILL BUCKET with cream rim, a visible handle, tipped to pour ONE teal drop; 4 two STICKER SHEETS, cream with a soft teal layer peeking behind, front sheet has one muted-gold five-point star and a curled peel corner; 5 a gently irregular cream artist PALETTE with three generous pools of teal, coral and gold; 6 a clear curved left-pointing UNDO ARROW painted as a softly modeled cream ribbon with a teal reverse edge.
Each cell shows an enlarged icon and two small consistent rounded-square button previews underneath: warm ivory on the left and deep navy on the right. Same scale and family weight across all six.
Prioritize clear functional silhouettes, broad highlights, very limited internal marks and gentle dimensionality that survives reduction. No sparkles, stars attached to tools, little rays, whiskers, decorative dashes or badges besides the book's true plus. Do not confuse the book plus with a sparkle or enclose it in a disk. Avoid pink/purple theming, faces, mascots, glossy plastic, photorealism, heavy shadows and industrial styling. No text, labels, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.

directions.name: Folded storybook
directions.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / icon-family concept art.
Input images are the existing Studioodle easel, open coloring book and curled paper-stack illustrations. Treat them as visual references ONLY. Borrow their cream paper, curled corners, muted teal/coral/gold palette, organic asymmetry and inviting handmade spirit, but make a distinct new icon direction.
Direction G: "Folded storybook". Elegant softly sculpted PAPER forms, closest in spirit to Paper Charms but with more flowing curved folds and a slightly more mature, calm balance. The paper is relatively smooth, lightly fibrous rather than crumpled; shallow raised layers, creamy curled edges and soft shadows create the depth. Sparse fine ink at selected edges only, no thick black outline, no wood grain, no metal. Not flat glyphs and not angular origami. Quietly magical through folds and form, not sparkle decoration.
Compose a landscape deep-navy board with exactly THREE columns and TWO rows. Six functions in reading order: (1) a clearly OPEN book made of two or three gracefully curved cream page layers with a muted-teal backing, one page corner gently lifting, a plain gold PLUS just outside its upper-right corner, absolutely no enclosing circle; (2) an artist BRUSH with a softly rounded coral-and-cream handle, simple collar and layered teal bristle tip, recognizable as a brush; (3) a tipped rounded FILL BUCKET formed from cream card with a curved open rim, arched handle, teal lining and ONE pouring drop; (4) two overlapping cream STICKER SHEETS with a softly curled peel corner, muted-sage backing and one bold gold five-point star, no other motifs; (5) a curved cream artist PALETTE with three large quiet teal/coral/gold paint wells and one thumb hole; (6) a clear curved left-pointing UNDO ARROW made from one broad paper strip, teal underside revealed by a gentle curled lower edge, no bow and no extra loop.
Each cell shows an enlarged icon with TWO small rounded-square button examples below: warm ivory on the left, navy on the right, exactly the same icon in both. Consistent icon scale and visual weight. Make the symbols inviting to click and legible when eventually simplified to 26–32px.
Only enough folds and shading to make each form alive. No tiny paper pictures, lettering, ornate borders, repetitive flecks, whiskers, sparkles or decorative stars attached to the tools or undo. The book's true plus is an action, not a star; the sticker's five-point star is its subject. Gender-neutral and equally welcoming to parents and kids, no baby styling, faces or mascots. No gloss, plastic, metallic bevels, deep extrusion, harsh shadows, words, labels, logos, numerals or watermark.
